title: Pure Ryu-Ge
summary: Ryu-Ge cards only, with generic staples; the page's Swordsoul, Dinomorphia and Yubel partners are left out. Ryu-Ge Rising searches Sosei Ryu-Ge Mistva, whose Pendulum Effect searches Ryu-Ge War Zone before it destroys itself into the face-up Extra Deck. War Zone then puts the Dinosaur, Sea Serpent and Wyrm Ryu-Ge in the hand, GY and banishment, where each one summons itself under its own condition. Mistva comes back from the Extra Deck as a Ritual Summon whenever a monster is destroyed, and places the Ryu-Ge Realm Continuous Spells, which give the Level 10s their disruption. The 2025 cards lead. Tensei Ryu-Ge Anva tributes a Ryu-Ge to summon itself and destroys a card, and as a Scale it negates responses to Ryu-Ge Spells. Ryu-Ge End shields the Ryu-Ge monsters from targeting and destroys a monster. Varudras is the generic Rank 10 the page recommends.
main: Sosei Ryu-Ge Mistva
As a Scale, searches a non-Pendulum Ryu-Ge card; returns from the Extra Deck as the boss.
Tensei Ryu-Ge Anva
Newest: tributes a Ryu-Ge to summon itself and destroy a card; negates responses as a Scale.
Kyoro Ryu-Ge Kaiva
Dinosaur: searches Dino Domains; summons itself after two destructions; destroys by Type count.
Kairo Ryu-Ge Emva
Sea Serpent: searches Sea Spires; revives itself; banishes their hand and redraws it.
Genro Ryu-Ge Hakva
Wyrm: searches Wyrm Winds; returns from banishment; recovers any Ryu-Ge card.
Ryu-Ge Rising
Quick-Play starter: searches a Ryu-Ge monster and adds a Pendulum to the Extra Deck.
Ryu-Ge War Zone
Field Spell: sets up the three Types from the Deck; summons three Ryu-Ge with Mistva face-up.
Ryu-Ge Realm - Dino Domains
Continuous: monster negate for the Dinosaur and Pendulum Ryu-Ge.
Ryu-Ge Realm - Sea Spires
Continuous: bounce on their turn for the Sea Serpent and Pendulum Ryu-Ge.
Ryu-Ge Realm - Wyrm Winds
Continuous: zeroes a monster's ATK on their turn for the Wyrm and Pendulum Ryu-Ge.
Ryu-Ge Rivalry
Summons a Ryu-Ge from the hand, Deck or GY; recycles a Realm for a draw.
Ryu-Ge End
Newest Trap: Ryu-Ge can't be targeted; shuffles two back to destroy a monster.
extra: Varudras, the Final Bringer of the End Times
Generic Rank 10 from two Level 10 Ryu-Ge: negates and destroys.
